result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback by covering affiliates and permitting transfer to an M&A successor, and it additionally covers contractors as contemplated by the preferred position. The edits are confined to licence scope and do not disturb the platform-use restrictions. It does not fully reach the preferred position: deleting “revocable” does not expressly make a paid-up licence perpetual and irrevocable or limit termination of a subscription licence to uncured material breach. Drafting quality is reduced because the clause retains “non-transferable, non-assignable” while later stating that the licence is transferable; this should be framed as an express exception. The margin comment also overstates the operative language by saying the licence ends only with the Agreement.
